name: OpsAgent
promise: Give it a goal. Watch it read your documents, call your systems and show its work before anything happens.
suggested: Which orders are waiting on a part we have in stock?
Raise a ticket for the overdue inspection on unit 7
What does the policy say about overtime approval?
how_it_works: Your goal goes to this app, which hands it to the Retrieval Agent with your identity.
The agent reads the Knowledge Box and calls this app's tools over MCP, one step at a time.
Every step is shown; actions run in dry-run until you turn them on.
